name: Emerald Wilds
description: Vast greenwoods, ruined waystones, waterfalls, and old Chocobo trails. The safest place to learn how far the road can really go.
hazard: Overgrown Trails

objectives.name: Forgotten Waystones
objectives.description: Recover the first waystones and reopen the old survey trail.

objectives.name: Crystal Waystation
objectives.description: Trace the ruined road to the abandoned Crystal Waystation.

objectives.name: Heart of the Wilds
objectives.description: Map the overgrown sanctuary where the oldest Ochu nests.

objectives.name: Emerald Pathfinder
objectives.description: Complete the Guild survey of the Emerald Wilds.

landmarks.name: Whisperroot Gate
landmarks.description: A living arch of roots marks the oldest surviving entrance to the Wilds.

landmarks.name: Silverfall Crossing
landmarks.description: A narrow stone crossing hidden behind a bright curtain of falling water.

landmarks.name: Crystal Waystation
landmarks.description: An abandoned Guild-era shelter still humming faintly with crystal light.

landmarks.name: Heartgrove Sanctuary
landmarks.description: A secluded green basin where the oldest trails converge beneath colossal trees.

resource: A hidden herb terrace survives beneath the canopy.
Fresh tracks lead to a rich gathering hollow.
A fallen waystone exposes untouched roots and mineral seams.
treasure: A vine-choked survey chest waits beside the old road.
Sunlight catches on something tucked beneath a ruined shrine.
A forgotten courier cache survived surprisingly well.
hazard: The trail vanishes beneath grasping roots and thorned brush.
A rain-swollen crossing gives way without warning.
A cloud of territorial spores erupts from the undergrowth.
traveler: A wandering botanist waves the party toward a sheltered rest.
A Moogle surveyor insists this shortcut was absolutely on the map.
A Chocobo caravan shares provisions beside an old marker stone.
chocobo: Your Chocobo catches the scent of an old stable trail.
A flock of wild Chocobos reveals a path hidden by the brush.
Your companion recognizes weathered hoof-marks beneath the moss.

rare_events.name: Moogle Survey Camp
rare_events.description: A tiny Guild survey camp appears where no map says one should be. The Moogle refuses to discuss this.

rare_events.name: Golden Cactuar Trail
rare_events.description: A glittering set of impossible footprints leads to a cache before abruptly ending at a tree.

rare_events.name: Ancient Chocobo Shrine
rare_events.description: An old stone shrine answers your companion with a warm crystal glow.

name: Ashen Highlands
description: Broken mountain roads, abandoned mines, blackened forts, and old Magitek debris scattered among volcanic ridges.
hazard: Unstable Terrain

objectives.name: Cinderwatch Survey
objectives.description: Secure the first safe route through the broken highland roads.

objectives.name: Ancient Forge Road
objectives.description: Locate the old forge road beneath the collapsed mining works.

objectives.name: Forge of the Ancients
objectives.description: Reach the volcanic forge complex and identify its guardian.

objectives.name: Highland Surveyor
objectives.description: Complete the Guild survey of the Ashen Highlands.

landmarks.name: Cinderwatch Gate
landmarks.description: The scorched gatehouse that once controlled passage into the highland mines.

landmarks.name: Mythril Hollow
landmarks.description: A collapsed mining chamber where exposed Mythril still glints through black stone.

landmarks.name: Magitek Wreckfield
landmarks.description: A broad slope littered with silent armor plates, conduits, and half-buried engines.

landmarks.name: Forgeheart Caldera
landmarks.description: A volcanic bowl surrounding the ancient forge complex at the region’s heart.

resource: A fractured mine wall exposes a fresh mineral seam.
Cooling lava has uncovered salvageable Magitek components.
The Chocobo paws at ash covering a forgotten supply vein.
treasure: A scorched quartermaster chest remains wedged beneath fallen masonry.
A Magitek wreck still contains a sealed maintenance compartment.
An abandoned mining lift holds one last locked crate.
hazard: Loose shale gives way beneath the mountain road.
A dormant vent erupts in a wave of furnace heat.
Unstable Magitek debris spits sparks across the trail.
traveler: A soot-covered smith trades directions for a moment near the fire.
A mining crew shares water and a safer route through the ridge.
A scavenger points out which Magitek wrecks are least likely to explode.
chocobo: Your Chocobo finds firm footing through a field of hot ash.
A sheltered mining road lets your companion pick up the pace.
Your Chocobo refuses one path so decisively that everyone agrees not to ask why.

rare_events.name: Dormant Magitek Cache
rare_events.description: A sealed Imperial field cache flickers back to life just long enough to open.

rare_events.name: Mythril Motherlode
rare_events.description: A cave-in reveals a mineral pocket untouched since the old mines closed.

rare_events.name: Forgekeeper’s Rest
rare_events.description: A stone shelter beside the forge road still radiates a strangely comforting warmth.

name: Mistfen Marshes
description: Fog, drowned temples, luminous fungi, and bog roads that seem determined to become lakes the moment you trust them.
hazard: Toxic Mire

objectives.name: Sunken Causeway
objectives.description: Mark a stable route through the first drowned roads.

objectives.name: Temple of Reeds
objectives.description: Find the outer ruins of the temple beneath the fog.

objectives.name: The Drowned Bell
objectives.description: Reach the deepest temple basin and identify the sovereign Malboro.

objectives.name: Mistfen Delver
objectives.description: Complete the Guild survey of the Mistfen Marshes.

landmarks.name: Lantern Bog
landmarks.description: A field of luminous fungi that turns the fog green-blue after dusk.

landmarks.name: Sunken Causeway
landmarks.description: The remains of an old stone road visible only where the marsh water runs clear.

landmarks.name: Temple of Reeds
landmarks.description: A half-drowned temple complex hidden behind walls of whispering reeds.

landmarks.name: The Drowned Bell
landmarks.description: A vast bronze bell beneath the deepest temple basin, heard when the water is still.

resource: A cluster of luminous fungi hides useful marsh reagents.
The reeds part around a rare patch of medicinal growth.
A half-submerged altar has gathered valuable scales and spores.
treasure: A shrine offering box rests just above the black waterline.
Something metallic gleams beneath a mat of floating reeds.
A sunken pilgrim pack is caught between the causeway stones.
hazard: The ground becomes water one step later than anyone would have preferred.
A pocket of toxic marsh gas rolls across the route.
Thick fog turns the marked path into three equally suspicious paths.
traveler: A lantern-bearing herbalist offers a draught and a warning.
A ferryman appears from the fog, accepts no payment, and answers no questions.
A soaked treasure hunter shares the location of the one dry patch for miles.
chocobo: Your Chocobo finds a sequence of barely submerged stepping stones.
Your companion stops before a patch of reeds moments before it collapses into deep water.
A distant Chocobo call guides the party through the fog.

rare_events.name: Tonberry Lantern Procession
rare_events.description: A silent line of Tonberries crosses the path. One leaves a small parcel behind. Nobody follows them.

rare_events.name: Healing Fen Spring
rare_events.description: Clear water bubbles from an ancient stone basin untouched by the surrounding mire.

rare_events.name: Sunken Reliquary
rare_events.description: A collapsed temple wall reveals a sealed reliquary beneath the water.

name: Frostveil Reach
description: Frozen lakes, whiteout mountain passes, and the half-buried remains of a fortress that stopped sending reports long ago.
hazard: Bitter Cold

objectives.name: Whitewind Pass
objectives.description: Establish a marked route through the first mountain pass.

objectives.name: Buried Watchtower
objectives.description: Recover the watchtower records beneath the snow.

objectives.name: Frostveil Bastion
objectives.description: Open the buried fortress approach and locate its guardian.

objectives.name: Frostveil Warden
objectives.description: Complete the Guild survey of Frostveil Reach.

mastery.bonus: Expedition Camp recovery +5% in Frostveil Reach

landmarks.name: Whitewind Cairn
landmarks.description: A towering trail marker built from black stone and permanently rimed with ice.

landmarks.name: Glass-Ice Lake
landmarks.description: A frozen lake so clear the old road can still be seen far beneath its surface.

landmarks.name: Buried Watchtower
landmarks.description: The upper floor of a fortress watchtower protruding from a century of snow.

landmarks.name: Frostveil Bastion
landmarks.description: The half-buried fortress that once guarded the northern pass.

resource: Wind strips snow from a ridge and exposes valuable frozen deposits.
A sheltered ice cave preserves materials in remarkable condition.
Tracks lead to a windbreak where useful remains have accumulated.
treasure: An old patrol chest is frozen into the wall of a ruined outpost.
A crack in the lake ice reveals a supply sled trapped below.
The remains of a watch post still hold a sealed emergency cache.
hazard: A whiteout erases the horizon in seconds.
A shelf of packed snow breaks loose above the trail.
The temperature drops sharply as the route climbs into exposed wind.
traveler: A bundled ranger shares hot broth and the next safe marker.
A stranded patrol has a fire going and room for one more traveler.
A merchant with terrible route-planning skills is nevertheless carrying excellent supplies.
chocobo: Your Chocobo digs out an old marker buried under fresh snow.
Your companion finds a wind-shadowed trail along the ridge.
A set of old Chocobo prints crosses the ice toward safer ground.

rare_events.name: Aurora Crystalfall
rare_events.description: An aurora ignites the ice and tiny crystal fragments begin falling like snow.

rare_events.name: Lost Expedition Camp
rare_events.description: A preserved Guild camp emerges from the drift with its stove and stores intact.

rare_events.name: Snow Chocobo Trail
rare_events.description: Fresh Chocobo tracks cut across terrain no ordinary traveler could cross safely.

name: The Astral Scar
description: A crystal-scarred battlefield where broken ruins float above fractured earth and reality behaves more like a suggestion.
hazard: Astral Instability

objectives.name: Crystal Fault
objectives.description: Stabilize the first survey route through the fractured ground.

objectives.name: Shattered Observatory
objectives.description: Recover readings from the floating observatory ruins.

objectives.name: The Broken Meridian
objectives.description: Trace the dimensional breach to the Rift Wyrm nesting ground.

objectives.name: Scarwalker
objectives.description: Complete the Guild survey of the Astral Scar.

mastery.bonus: Treasure events +5% in the Astral Scar

landmarks.name: Crystal Fault
landmarks.description: A glowing fracture in the earth where crystal growths pulse with unstable light.

landmarks.name: Floating Reliquary
landmarks.description: A small ruin suspended above the ground by forces the Guild has chosen not to name.

landmarks.name: Shattered Observatory
landmarks.description: Broken astronomical instruments orbit the ruins of an ancient observatory.

landmarks.name: The Broken Meridian
landmarks.description: A vast line of fractured crystal marking the deepest stable route into the Scar.

resource: A crystal bloom forms around a pocket of condensed aether.
A floating ruin sheds a fragment rich with salvageable material.
Reality briefly becomes generous and deposits something useful beside the trail.
treasure: A chest drifts several feet above where the floor used to be.
A sealed reliquary rotates slowly inside a pocket of still air.
A time-worn pack appears beside the route before its owner does.
hazard: Gravity changes its mind halfway across the path.
A pulse from the Scar turns stable ground into floating shards.
A ripple of astral distortion tears across the route.
traveler: A time-lost scholar asks what year it is, then offers useful supplies.
A Moogle cartographer appears, checks three compasses, and quietly puts all of them away.
Another expedition emerges from a route that does not currently exist.
chocobo: Your Chocobo reacts to a distortion moments before the road folds sideways.
Your companion chooses a path through floating stones with alarming confidence.
A shimmer reveals hoofprints hanging briefly in midair.

rare_events.name: Rift Cache
rare_events.description: A supply chest flickers between two positions until your Chocobo chooses the correct one.

rare_events.name: Time-Lost Moogle
rare_events.description: A confused Moogle insists the Guild sent them yesterday. Their supplies are still useful.

rare_events.name: Celestial Crystal Bloom
rare_events.description: A vast crystal flower opens as the Scar stabilizes for a few precious moments.
